title: Leonhard Center awards $19,093 for LogicForge adaptive microlearning
body: The Leonhard Center at Penn State awarded $19,093 through its Grants for Entrepreneurial Mindset for Student Success (GEMSS) program for “LogicForge: Adaptive Microlearning for Discrete Mathematics Proficiency.” Suman Saha served as principal investigator, with Mahfuza Farooque as co-principal investigator and Kyusun Choi as a collaborator. The award supported the project from January through December 2025.
